_comment: Budget 2027, Vallentuna. Source: Kommunplan 2027-2029 (https://www.vallentuna.se/download/18.7078fd331a12f52fa5537917/1792411963021/05.%20Kommunplan%202027-2029.pdf). Posts and income are the governing coalition's (KP 2027: Figur 15 p.38, 9.1 Resultaträkning p.31). Alternatives: Socialdemokraterna p.100-101 (decimals from p.100), Vänsterpartiet p.136, Miljöpartiet p.143, Sverigedemokraterna p.120 (image). Amounts in mnkr. adjustPercent sets a post's own slider span (± percent; default 70–130%). Import: pnpm budget-import --file data/budgets/vallentuna-2027.json [--production] [--apply]. Finansieringsenheten, finansiella kostnader and finansiella intäkter are folded into one locked net post (coalition 10 + 14 − 15 = 9; S/V/MP 14 + 14 − 15 = 13) — small, and not something budget work can change, but they count in the balance. Avskrivningar is deliberately not a post: the plan subtracts it in the operating statement and adds it back in the income statement, so it nets to zero — as its own post it would be counted twice.

expenses.note: Finansieringsenheten 10 mnkr + finansiella kostnader 14 mnkr − finansiella intäkter 15 mnkr. Ingår i balansen men påverkas inte i budgetarbetet.

alternatives.label: Sverigedemokraterna
alternatives._note: SD's own structure: Socialnämnd 429 + Äldreomsorgsnämnden 354 = Socialnämnden 783. Their combined Fritids- och kulturnämnden (129) can't be split across our two posts, so SD has no marker on Fritidsnämnden/Kulturnämnden. The plan gives no SD income statement, so their net financial posts assume the coalition's financial costs (14) and income (15): 14 + 14 − 15 = 13.
